body: MOBILE TOUCH AUDIT REPORT - WCAG 2.5.8. Date: 2026-02-22. RESULT: PASS at mobile (max-width 600px). Partial gap at tablet (601-1023px touch). WHAT PASSES: shared/styles.css line 1077-1080 applies min-height:44px to all a, button, select, input inside @media max-width 600px. exam.html links shared/styles.css and this rule applies. hint-btn, graph-btn, nav-btn, btn-primary all receive 44px min-height on mobile. WHAT NEEDS ATTENTION: 1. Tablet touch devices (601-1023px): no min-height rule. .hint-btn and .graph-btn at 6px padding calculate to ~32px height. Below 44px threshold. 2. exam.html hint buttons: own CSS sets padding 6px 14px. At >600px width no min-height override exists. RECOMMENDATION: Extend shared/styles.css @media touch rule to max-width 1024px OR use a pointer:coarse media query. Pointer:coarse is more accurate for touch detection: @media (pointer:coarse) { button, a, select, input { min-height: 44px; } }. This covers all touch devices regardless of width. SPEC: Replace current @media max-width 600px min-height rule with @media (pointer:coarse) selector. Same 44px value. Affect: all button, a, select, input elements on touch devices. Zero visual change on desktop (pointer:fine).
